# Oliver Murray

> Personal website of Oliver Murray, a software engineer from Australia building products at early-stage startups in the US.

## Pages

- [Home](https://omurray.dev): Introduction to Oliver Murray
- [About](https://omurray.dev/about): Oliver's background - moved from Australia to the US in 2021 to work at early-stage startups
- [Projects](https://omurray.dev/projects): Products and side projects, including Trail Challenge (https://trailchallenge.com), comedy.fyi, Backyard, Fireside, and thinvalue.poker
- [Resources](https://omurray.dev/resources): Articles, podcasts, and videos worth sharing
- [Travel](https://omurray.dev/travel): Places Oliver has travelled
- [Hobbies](https://omurray.dev/hobbies): Running and hiking, making coffee, natural wine, and sports
